Suggested cards from long notes: a note over 12,000 characters, such as an imported document, can now be used with *Suggest cards* one part at a time. Existing study behavior, FSRS scheduling, data lifecycle rules, file import, and the backup format are unchanged.

- Open a long note and choose *Suggest cards*. Synapse offers the note in parts of up to 12,000 characters, each ending where a paragraph ends, and you choose one under *Part of the note*.
- The screen shows the part you chose, the model reads only that part, and each suggested card is checked against it, as before with whole notes. Come back to *Suggest cards* for the other parts.
- When an imported file's text is over 12,000 characters, the new-note form now says that *Suggest cards* will offer it in parts.
- The parts are chosen by Synapse; you can't set where they begin or end, suggest from several at once, or see which parts you've already used.

Windows x64 installers:

- Synapse_0.5.1_x64_en-US.msi
- Synapse_0.5.1_x64-setup.exe

The installers are unsigned, so Windows SmartScreen may warn on first run. They were built on GitHub's Windows machines by the Release workflow, after its tests passed.
